import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from scipy import sparse
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
TARGET_COLS = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Prepare text data
train_texts = train_df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)

# Stratified train/validation split for hold-out evaluation
train_texts, val_texts, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_texts,
    train_df["author"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["author"],
)

# Feature Extraction: Character n-grams TF-IDF
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 4),
    max_features=60000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents=None,
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)

# Hyperparameters tuned for sparse text features and log-loss optimization
lgbm_params = {
    "n_estimators": 400,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 60,
    "class_weight": "balanced",
    "min_child_samples": 25,
    "reg_alpha": 0.5,
    "reg_lambda": 0.5,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Train and Validate on Hold-Out Set
val_model = LGBMClassifier(**lgbm_params)
val_model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train)
val_probs = val_model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)

# Compute Official Metric on Hold-Out
holdout_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=TARGET_COLS)
print(f"Holdout Multi-class Log-Loss: {holdout_logloss:.6f}")

# Retrain on Full Training Data for Final Test Predictions
X_full_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
y_full = train_df["author"]

final_model = LGBMClassifier(**lgbm_params)
final_model.fit(X_full_vec, y_full)

# Generate Test Predictions
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"].fillna("").astype(str))
test_probs = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Format and Save Submission
submission = sample_sub.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(TARGET_COLS):
    submission[col] = test_probs[:, i]

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully at ./submission/submission.csv")
